description: Audited seed of cross-feature handoff milestones. This is not the complete 38-task Feature2 backlog. Source fixtures are never production approvals.

tasks.title: Immutable MIT OpenVTO model and separate garment demonstration inputs
tasks.acceptance: Merged original-byte provenance, license and distinct synthetic model and garment inputs; never VTON output.

tasks.title: Original-byte handoff to other feature consumers
tasks.acceptance: Merged versioned original-byte handoff; no claim of reviewed commercial garment-on-model output.

tasks.title: Original MIT Creative Director exporter in coordinator main
tasks.acceptance: Coordinator merged PR #551, verified latest main CI and versioned script/shot/caption contracts; separate spoken voice and human approval.

tasks.title: Professional editor and FFmpeg contract integrated into main
tasks.acceptance: Coordinator merged supported source editor and render pipeline; mock visuals remain explicitly noncommercial.

tasks.title: AutoBroll semantic editing source integrated into main
tasks.acceptance: Coordinator merged edit proposals; production-quality audio transcription and signed edits remain separate.

tasks.title: Wan2.2 GPU-off consumer and private-import source accepted
tasks.acceptance: Stacked source PR merged under coordinator review; real Wan inference and main release require separate verification.

tasks.title: Independent original-voice / captions fixture and quality gate
tasks.acceptance: Test original WAV/metadata and caption quality against versioned fixture; actual TTS, provider rights and editorial release still separate.

tasks.title: Cross-feature original-image CPU media contract regression
tasks.acceptance: Run original-byte SHA, licensed synthetic fixture and CPU FFmpeg/private-import regression; confirm no Wan or VTON generated media.

tasks.title: Validate Feature3 technical MP4 as editor test media
tasks.acceptance: Verify exact Actions artifact bytes, video codecs, immutable provenance and negative rights tests; never mark consumer signed E2E passed.

tasks.title: Real model and garment approval with independently reviewed rights
tasks.acceptance: Authorized original retailer garment/model, current likeness/commercial license and independent human reviewer evidence.

tasks.title: Ratify Wan2.2 versus Part3 Wan2.7 job, lease, credit and storage contract
tasks.acceptance: Coordinator freezes compatible versioned native Wan2.2 704x1280 121f/24fps and one-charge/tenant rights interface, not the incompatible Wan2.7 default.

tasks.title: Explicit licensed CUDA/ComfyUI and bounded A100 authorization
tasks.acceptance: User approves exact one-shot cost, weight license/provenance and A100 stop/kill plan; remains GPU OFF by default.

tasks.title: Genuine approved Wan2.2 model wearing approved garment
tasks.acceptance: One authorized genuine Wan video, private media/ledger, full human product and temporal QA with bounded spend.

tasks.title: Integrate reviewed Feature2 storyboard with Feature4 editor
tasks.acceptance: Versioned F2-to-F4 source scene/caption/music contract, exact-head CI and coordinator integrated main.

tasks.title: Execute approved Feature7 semantic edit decisions
tasks.acceptance: Versioned approved cut/caption and B-roll semantics supported by actual renderer, preserving original audio and signed rights.

tasks.title: Owner-reviewed high-quality retailer garment Reel
tasks.acceptance: Reviewed product fidelity, edit quality, captions, legally usable music/voice and signed final private H264/AAC output.
